title: Window Replacement Contracts Series Price Book
content:
# Window Replacement Contracts — Series Price Book

The installed list price of a Window Replacement Contracts series is quoted per standard-size window opening, before any discount program. Each series also sets the smallest signed contract price it accepts, the largest number of openings one contract may carry, and the fewest openings a contract may keep after openings are removed for credit.

| Series | List price per standard-size opening | Minimum signed contract price | Maximum openings per contract | Fewest openings kept after a removal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | $612.00 | $1495.00 | 40 | 1 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | $748.00 | $1495.00 | 40 | 1 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | $879.00 | $1995.00 | 40 | 1 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | $1086.00 | $2495.00 | 36 | 1 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | $1238.00 | $2995.00 | 36 | 1 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $1472.00 | $3495.00 | 30 | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

- The opening price is a per-opening figure for one standard-size opening in that series; it is the price before any discount program is applied.
- The minimum contract price and the maximum opening count are series limits on a single contract, not on a household.
- The fewest-openings figure is the count a contract must still carry after openings are removed for credit.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical quote for 3 openings in a series priced at a hypothetical $1,000 per opening carries a list price for the openings of $3,000 (three times $1,000) before options and before any discount program. The figures in this illustration are invented and are not series prices.
